svg.title: How a sentence becomes token IDs
svg.desc: The sentence "Self-attention is powerful" is split into six subword tokens, then each token is mapped to an integer token ID.

g.text: How a sentence becomes token IDs
A sentence becomes subword tokens, and each token becomes one integer ID.
